'''Camp 27''' was an Imperial prison camp located in the [[Shadow Town]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], in which the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] held prisoners of war.
